title: Bloodsucking Bastards
description: An office worker (Fran Kranz) springs into action after learning that his colleague (Pedro Pascal) is a scheming vampire.

title: Mortuary
description: A girl (Mary McDonough) and her boyfriend (David Wallace) suspect her mother (Lynda Day George) and an undertaker are embalming people too soon.

title: The Nest
description: A scientist, a sheriff, an exterminator and an island mayor's daughter go on the hunt for mutant meat-eating cockroaches that are terrorizing a peaceful New England fishing village.

title: Rabid
description: Surgery leaves a Montreal motorcyclist (Marilyn Chambers) with a bloodsucking appendage in her armpit.

title: Masters of Horror
description:
S02 E03 — The V Word
Two teenage boys break into a mortuary to see dead bodies, but what they find is more than they bargained for.

title: Masters of Horror
description:
S02 E07 — Screwfly Solution
A deadly virus infects men across the country, and it could mean the end of mankind, since it causes men to kill every woman they see.

title: Grave Encounters
description: The crew of a ghost-hunting TV show goes insane after being locked in an abandoned psychiatric hospital.

title: Hell House LLC
description: A documentary crew visits Hell House to investigate what really happened 5 years earlier, when 15 people were killed during a haunted house tour.

title: Carnival of Souls
description: After taking a job as a church organist, the sole survivor of a fatal car crash encounters phantoms that lure her to a deserted carnival outside of town.

title: Creepshow III
description: Ghoulish stories revolve around a remote control, a strange radio, a murderous call-girl, an engagement and a ghost.

title: The Taking of Deborah Logan
description: Mia records the daily lives of Deborah and her daughter Sarah as part of her thesis. As the days progress, strange things happen around Deborah, and it becomes apparent something has taken control of her.

title: Demonic Toys
description: Two gunrunners and a pregnant policewoman (Tracy Scoggins) are trapped in a warehouse with a bad boy's toys.

title: The Exorcist III
description: A police detective (George C. Scott) investigates a series of slayings done in the style of an executed killer (Brad Dourif).

title: Nightbreed
description: A young man's quest to end his nightmares leads him to a cemetery where monsters have retreated to escape mankind.

title: Silent Hill: Revelation
description: When her adoptive father disappears, Sharon Da Silva is drawn into a strange and terrifying alternate reality that holds answers to the horrific nightmares that have plagued her since childhood.
